steps.content: You are now merely carried along by the currents, devoid of eyes, form, and all senses, powerless to stop this everlasting drift.
How long has it been? Perhaps an eternity, or maybe just an instant—you cannot tell, for time has lost all meaning here... But then, you stumble upon something.
Unable to see it, you can only vaguely sense something breaking apart. Then, abruptly, the world is illuminated once again.
You finally have a clear view of where you are—an infinitely vast and desolate darkness, yet in certain places, distant and faint stars still exist.

What lies there? You are uncertain, but you yearn to find out the answer. However, stripped of form, you cannot steer your course. You are once again driven by chaos, drifting towards an uncharted horizon.
In an imperceptible space behind you, an aged monocle shatters, dissolving into invisible dust.
